entries.target_ja: 主要4社の2025年以降カタログ
entries.change_ja: 未処理行を一括補完し、意味上の重複を統合
entries.change_en: Filled unprocessed rows and merged semantic duplicates
entries.reason_ja: 代表profileだけを追加した最初のバックフィルでは、既存models.jsonの追加モデルが未評価・未監査のまま残っていたため。Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.4 mini/nano、GPT-5 mini/nano、GPT-4.1 mini/nano、Grok 3 mini、Gemini 2.0系などを補完し、GPT-4.5 / o4-mini / o3-mini / Gemini 3系 / Claude 3.7等の別表記重複をcanonical familyへ統合。
entries.reason_en: The original representative-profile backfill left additional models already present in models.json unevaluated and unaudited. Filled rows such as Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.4 mini/nano, GPT-5 mini/nano, GPT-4.1 mini/nano, Grok 3 mini and Gemini 2.0 models, and canonicalized alternate labels for GPT-4.5, o4-mini, o3-mini, Gemini 3 and Claude 3.7 families.

entries.change_ja: 主要アンカーをAA Intelligence Index v5.0.1へ移行し、v4.3.2→v5.0.1の線形ブリッジ（ペア15件フィット）を登録
entries.change_en: Moved the primary anchor to AA Intelligence Index v5.0.1 and registered a linear v4.3.2 to v5.0.1 bridge fitted on 15 paired models
entries.reason_ja: AAがIndexをv5.0.1へ更新し、v4.3.2の新規測定が得られなくなったため。実測のあるモデルは実測を採用し、測定のない旧モデルはブリッジ換算の参考値で補う方針とした。
entries.reason_en: Artificial Analysis moved the Index to v5.0.1 and no new v4.3.2 measurements are available. Measured models adopt measured values; unmeasured older models are covered by bridge-converted reference values.

entries.change_ja: Gemini 4ファミリーを新規登録（Hydrogen xhigh 54、Argon high 50、Carbon high 60、いずれもAA v5.0.1実測）
entries.change_en: Registered the Gemini 4 family (Hydrogen xhigh 54, Argon high 50, Carbon high 60; all measured on AA v5.0.1)
entries.reason_ja: Gemini 4ファミリーが発売され、特にHydrogenがAntigravityの実行役として実用段階に入ったため。
entries.reason_en: The Gemini 4 family has been released, and Hydrogen in particular has entered practical use as the Antigravity execution model.

entries.change_ja: v5.0.1の実測値で15件を再登録し、旧評価をsupersededにした
entries.change_en: Re-registered 15 models with measured v5.0.1 values and marked the previous evaluations superseded
entries.reason_ja: 再アンカーに伴い、実測が得られたモデルは換算ではなく実測へ置き換えるため。
entries.reason_en: As part of the re-anchor, models with fresh measurements were replaced with measured values rather than converted ones.
